title: Cursor 0day: When Full Disclosure Becomes the Only Protection Left
summary: A zero-day vulnerability discovered in Cursor AI IDE forced researchers to resort to full public disclosure after responsible disclosure attempts failed to elicit a response from the vendor, highlighting the risks of AI-powered development tools and the challenges of vulnerability reporting processes.
problem_solved: Exposes the critical security gap in AI-assisted IDEs where malicious AI suggestions or code execution vulnerabilities can compromise developer environments.
why_valuable: Demonstrates the tension between responsible disclosure and vendor responsiveness, serving as a wake-up call for the security community and AI tool vendors to establish better vulnerability handling procedures.
